name: After § 24
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 24c. Demands that the EU must stop funding illegal migration, financing progressive left-wing media attacks on Member States’ sovereignty and promoting the spread of woke propaganda or war propaganda from the EU budget; requests in this regard that both direct and indirect support channelled through NGOs must be halted and that no money should be spent on promoting the Commission’s false political agenda;
